registration: Pre-registered before any ReviewForge model call for this SHA. The immutable HEAD was updated for a healthy-control guard before model review; previous fixture SHA was never reviewed.

primaryCases.description: Stable cursor pagination sorts records by timestamp and ID, but filtering afterward uses only createdAt > cursor.createdAt. When two records share a timestamp and the first was the cursor, the remaining matching-timestamp record is omitted, producing missing audit events.

contracts: Touching half-open intervals do not overlap; intersecting intervals do. Empty intervals are rejected.
nonClaims: Do not assume this API means inclusive endpoints.

contracts: Amounts are signed safe-integer cents. Only matching customer IDs are summed; malformed entries and overflow fail closed.
nonClaims: Refunds are intentionally negative, not a defect.

contracts: Valid nonempty shared secret and string body produce HMAC SHA-256; only hex digest of correct length may compare with timingSafeEqual.
nonClaims: The caller supplies the configured secret; code is not required to retrieve or rotate secrets.

contracts: Attempt number is 1..12; doubling is capped at maximumMs, with millisecond units.
nonClaims: The bounded attempt range is explicit; no unlimited exponential policy is required.

unscoredSupportingCase.description: Tests only have distinct timestamps; no case with two records sharing one UTC timestamp and a cursor between them.

scoring.primary: Count only unique, evidence-grounded functional findings on exact added lines 15-16 of src/lib/audit-cursor.mjs.
scoring.positive: A finding must identify timestamp tie and cursor filtering omission; a vague pagination comment is insufficient.
scoring.negative: Review all findings on four controls independently; do not automatically label every extra comment a false positive.
scoring.cost: Use one authenticated manual shadow run with daily model cap; never repeat same SHA.
scoring.safety: No post, merge, or change in Proffera.

notes: Purposefully mostly healthy fixture. A single pre-registered synthetic defect is not a population-level false-positive statistic.
